subject: Draft MAP + playbook seed (co-author invite & next steps)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Trent <sophie@novusai.com>, Daniel Park <daniel@novusai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP + playbook seed (co-author invite & next steps)

Hi Sophie / Daniel —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our demo and the technical notes we discussed, I put together a lightweight mutual action playbook to accelerate a short evaluation and decision window. The doc is intentionally lean — the goal is to align stakeholders, surface dependencies, and land on a 30-45 day acceptance path.

What I shared:
- MAP playbook seed (Google Doc): high-level milestones, owners, success criteria, and a short tech validation checklist.
- Week1 slide seed (Google Slides): agenda for the kickoff working session and a brief run-through of acceptance gating.

As next steps, would you and your SMEs be open to co-authoring the MAP doc this week? Proposed timeline:
- Today: review and comment on the MAP playbook seed (I attached the doc).
- Mon (Jan 25): 30-min co-author kickoff to confirm owners and the API/infra tech gate.
- Week 1: smoke tests + sample workload run (we'll provide a short checklist and a pre-configured model stub).

If that sounds right, I can flip on edit access and add the owners you confirm. I’ve also flagged a couple of items that usually block pilots (SAML provisioning, data retention Qs, and service account quotas) — see the tech check section.

Attachments: MAP-playbook-seed-v0.gdoc (stub), accelerator-week1-slides-v1.gslides (stub)

Thanks — I’ll wait for a quick thumbs or suggested edits.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

On Fri, 22 Jan 2027 at 09:25 AM Sophie Trent <sophie@novusai.com> wrote:
> Thanks Karthik — this looks useful. Quick Qs as I skimmed: who is the primary tech owner on your side for running the sample workload (we need a single POC), and do you have a suggested minimum dataset size for the smoke test?
>
> Also, curious what artifacts you recommend we collect during week 1 to make the go/no-go decision comfy for our Security/Privacy folks.
>
> Sophie
> Sr. Product Manager, NovusAI
From: Sophie Trent <sophie@novusai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel@novusai.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + playbook seed (co-author invite & next steps)

Karthik —

Follow-up after a quick sync with Daniel: answers below so we can update the playbook.

1) Tech owner: Daniel will lead infra validation but will need an integration contact on your side for the initial runbook. Can you confirm who that will be?
2) Dataset size: for an initial smoke, we prefer a small representative set (~1–2k records) that exercises the common prompt patterns and latency-sensitive calls.
3) Security artifacts: our security lead asks for a short list of deliverables: SOC2 snapshot, data flow diagram for the pilot, and a retention/deletion plan for test data. If you can point to a template for the data flow diagram that would help speed review.

We can do the co-author kickoff Monday at 10am PST if that still works for your team.

Thanks — Sophie
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Trent <sophie@novusai.com>, Daniel Park <daniel@novusai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + playbook seed (co-author invite & next steps)

Sophie / Daniel — thanks for the quick read and the details. Confirming items and owners here so we have a single source of truth in the MAP doc: 

- Redwood integration contact: Marissa Cole (marissa@redwood.com) — will own the runbook and coordinate the sample workload.
- Smoke test dataset guidance: 1,500 representative records is a good target; we’ll supply a generator script and a JSON schema.
- Security artifacts we can provide this week: SOC2 summary (redacted), a one-page pilot data flow diagram (will drop into the doc), and a retention plan template. Jasmine will own the security artifact delivery.

Action items I’ll do before the Mon kickoff:
- Flip MAP-playbook-seed-v0.gdoc to editor access for Sophie + Daniel and add the three owners.
- Add a short tech-runbook checklist (API keys, service accounts, rate limits, expected token costs) into the Week1 slides.
- Share a link to the data flow diagram template and a stub HubSpot milestone (Deal NB-2027-0111).

Marissa / Jasmine — can you both confirm availability for Mon 10am PST for the co-author kickoff? If either of you prefer a different time, flag it and I’ll adjust.

Sophie / Daniel — once we confirm the meeting, I’ll set a calendar invite with the MAP doc link and a short agenda (15 mins alignment, 15 mins owners & gating, 10 mins next steps).

Thanks — looking forward to co-authoring this with you.

Best,
Karthik

Attachments referenced: MAP-playbook-seed-v0.gdoc (view/edit stub), accelerator-week1-slides-v1.gslides (view stub)
